question: For ports with status = 'DOWN' that belong to tenant ID '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57', show each port’s ID, tenant ID, MAC address, and security group ID, along with (1) the port’s rank within its security group by port ID, (2) the total number of such DOWN ports in that security group, (3) the average of those totals across security groups as a benchmark, (4) a category per security group (HIGH_USER/LOW_USER/AVERAGE_USER) based on that benchmark, and also (5) the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within its security group (ordered by standard attribute ID) plus (6) the deviation of the port’s standard attribute ID from the overall average standard attribute ID across these DOWN ports. Do not return any rounded answers. Categorize each security group as 'HIGH_USER' (at least 50% more than average), 'LOW_USER' (at least 50% less than average), or 'AVERAGE_USER'.

prediction.sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT p.id AS port_id, p.tenant_id, p.mac_address, b.security_group_id, p.standard_attr_id
  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings b ON b.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS sg_total
  FROM base
  GROUP BY security_group_id
),
bench AS (
  SELECT AVG(sg_total) AS avg_total FROM sg_counts
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_attr FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.port_id,
  b.tenant_id,
  b.mac_address,
  b.security_group_id,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id ORDER BY b.port_id) AS port_rank,
  c.sg_total,
  a.avg_total AS benchmark_avg,
  CASE
    WHEN c.sg_total >= a.avg_total * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
    WHEN c.sg_total <= a.avg_total * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
    ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER'
  END AS category,
  SUM(b.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY b.security_group_id ORDER BY b.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_attr,
  b.standard_attr_id - o.avg_attr AS attr_deviation
FROM base b
JOIN sg_counts c ON c.security_group_id = b.security_group_id
CROSS JOIN bench a
CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY b.security_group_id, b.port_id

  FROM ports p
  JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON sgpb.port_id = p.id
  WHERE p.status = 'DOWN' AND p.tenant_id = '98333a1a28e746fa8c629c83a818ad57'
),
sg_counts AS (
  SELECT security_group_id, COUNT(*) AS down_port_count
  FROM base_ports
  GROUP BY security_group_id
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(down_port_count) AS avg_down_port_count FROM sg_counts
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(standard_attr_id) AS avg_std_attr FROM base_ports
),
ranked_ports AS (
  SELECT bp.port_id, bp.tenant_id, bp.mac_address, bp.security_group_id, bp.standard_attr_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bp.security_group_id ORDER BY bp.port_id) AS port_rank,
    sc.down_port_count,
    b.avg_down_port_count AS benchmark,
    CASE WHEN sc.down_port_count > b.avg_down_port_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_USER'
         WHEN sc.down_port_count < b.avg_down_port_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_USER'
         ELSE 'AVERAGE_USER' END AS sg_category,
    SUM(bp.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY bp.security_group_id ORDER BY bp.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
  FROM base_ports bp
  JOIN sg_counts sc ON sc.security_group_id = bp.security_group_id
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
)
SELECT rp.port_id, rp.tenant_id, rp.mac_address, rp.security_group_id, rp.port_rank,
  rp.down_port_count, rp.benchmark, rp.sg_category, rp.running_sum_std_attr,
  (rp.standard_attr_id - o.avg_std_attr) AS deviation_from_avg_std_attr
FROM ranked_ports rp CROSS JOIN overall o
ORDER BY rp.security_group_id, rp.port_id
